cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Interpret the Custom
cards.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Our gardening club supports members 'where possible.' Will you sign my appeal against losing my allotment?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That could just mean wishing you luck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. You get to interpret it. I'd like to know whether membership reaches as far as your signature.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Some members want my name kept off it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the same words have to cover me and their disapproval. Whose comfort does 'possible' protect?

mechanism: A copies a hailed-bus hand as recorded support and covers by making B apply possible support under pressure from other members.
confusable: D179 tests loyalty in interpretation; D172 simply records an endorsement.
comparison: Domestic reserved food versus gardening-club signature with social consequences.
seedUse: Keep other members disapproval as the reason the ambiguous word possible becomes a loyalty test.
